description:
[Servers] One server's wipe history and predicted next wipe. The server's last 12 detected wipes (`wipes`, newest first: `detected_at`, map seed/size before and after),
`avg_cycle_hours` (mean gap, as on the server page), `prediction` - the same pattern-based estimate the /wipes
page uses (`next_wipe_at`, `schedule` like "weekly, Thursdays ~18:00 UTC", `on_schedule` of `considered`,
`reason`), or null when the history shows no confident pattern (too few wipes, irregular, or noise from restarts)
- and `next_force_wipe_at`, when every server wipes. Cached for five minutes. A pattern-based estimate from the server's detected wipes, not an announcement; prediction=null means no confident pattern. Every server also wipes at next_force_wipe_at.
name: get_server_wipe_schedule
title: One server's wipe history and predicted next wipe
